scope: Technical candidate screening of every original image in the frozen N0 adult cohort; no generated age outputs, model loading, identity recognition or quality acceptance.

observations.threshold_basis: Eight is a prespecified uncalibrated retrieval cutoff, not a validated duplicate, identity, age or leakage threshold.

algorithm.color: Convert to RGB; no ICC color management transform
algorithm.pixel_sha256: SHA256(b'agemorph3d-rgb-v1\0' + struct.pack('>II', width, height) + b'RGB\0' + RGB bytes); \0 denotes one NUL byte
algorithm.comparison: Right > left for horizontal; below > above for vertical
algorithm.bit_order: Row-major, first comparison is the most significant of 64 bits
algorithm.diagnostic: Per matched view-pair mean absolute grayscale byte difference divided by 255; no per-image normalization and no candidate filtering
algorithm.candidate: At least one of all four view-pairs jointly satisfies both Hamming cutoffs; retain every matched view-pair and deduplicate only the unordered image pair
algorithm.exact_duplicates: Record same file SHA-256 and every equal dimension-bound pixel SHA-256 view-pair separately from perceptual candidate labels

accounting.comparable_pairs: s * (s - 1) / 2 for successfully verified and decoded originals
accounting.uncomparable_pairs: requested_pairs minus comparable_pairs; failures remain in the requested denominator
accounting.source_integrity: Verify size and SHA-256 on the same bounded byte snapshot before decoding; recheck every source after analysis and record drift as failure. Declared or actual over-limit sources are not decoded or unbounded-hashed: explicitly record not_verified_size_limit and fail integrity.
accounting.grouping: Preserve N0 identity and use groups; no automatic reassignment, removal or duplicate-person inference
accounting.components: Similarity edges only; transitive components are review queues, never proof that every pair is duplicate

output_policy.human_candidate_review: Not performed by the scanner; any later visual contact with research holdout originals must be recorded separately

known_limits: Cropping, rotation, local overlap, strong editing, background replacement or resampling may be missed.
Smooth backgrounds and similar composition may create false positives, including across different identities.
No measured retrieval recall or false positive rate is available; zero candidates cannot certify absence of leakage.
Same decoded pixels under this decoder are not independently verified image provenance or age truth.
Research mirror permission and independent evaluation prerequisites remain unchanged.
